analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price (KRW 29,500) above SMA5 (KRW 29,307), below SMA20 (KRW 35,634) and SMA50 (KRW 35,197): attempting short-term rebound, mid-term trend weak.
· Significantly below SMA100 (KRW 39,716) and SMA200 (KRW 36,050): maintaining strong mid-to-long-term downtrend.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.2 → 34.1): entering oversold, weak momentum continues.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-698.3549 → -1050.7967): worsening, strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band KRW 27,356): approaching lower band, band width is wide at 46.46%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 29,075): close to 5-day low (KRW 28,080), above Pivot S1 (KRW 24,858).
· Swing resistance (KRW 30,570): close to 5-day high (KRW 30,555), potential for short-term rebound if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (No Higher Low, No Lower High): sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.52x): contracted compared to previous average, reducing confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): insufficient grounds for buy signal due to RSI entering oversold and weak ADX trend, maintaining wait-and-see conditions.
